data = """date,time,product,size,price,quantity,payment_method,customer_age_group,is_takeaway,total
2024-01-01,00:00,Cappuccino,Large,4.18,2,Credit Card,55+,1,8.36
2024-01-01,02:00,Cappuccino,Medium,4.01,3,Credit Card,35-44,1,12.03
2024-01-01,04:00,Tea,Small,5.22,1,Credit Card,18-24,1,5.22

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=5)

# 1. Total sales by product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)

age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(age_sales)],
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(age_sales))
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group')

# 3. Quantity sold by size
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_qty = df.groupby('size')['quantity'].sum()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_qty = size_qty.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_qty.index])
bars3 = ax3.bar(size_qty.index, size_qty.values, color=colors[:len(size_qty)])
ax3.set_xlabel('Size')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Quantity Sold')
ax3.set_title('Quantity Sold by Size')
for i, v in enumerate(size_qty.values):
    ax3.text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Payment method breakdown
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
payment_counts = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
x = range(len(payment_counts))
width = 0.35
bars4a = ax4.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], payment_counts['sum'], width, 
                  label='Total ($)', color=colors[0])
ax4_twin = ax4.twinx()
bars4b = ax4_twin.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], payment_counts['count'], width,
                       label='# Transactions', color=colors[2])
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', color=colors[0])
ax4_twin.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', color=colors[2])
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(payment_counts.index)
ax4.set_title('Sales by Payment Method')
ax4.legend(loc='upper left')
ax4_twin.legend(loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
